original_query: select o_year, sum(case when nation = 'ALGERIA' then volume else 0 end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from ( select extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume, n2.n_name as nation from part, supplier, lineitem, orders, customer, nation n1, nation n2, region where p_partkey = l_partkey and s_suppkey = l_suppkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_custkey = c_custkey and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'AFRICA' and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31' and p_type = 'LARGE BURNISHED TIN' ) as all_nations group by o_year order by o_year;
rewritten_query:
SELECT o_year,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_algeria THEN volume ELSE 0 END) / SUM(volume) AS mkt_share
FROM (
    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year,
           l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) AS volume,
           s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'ALGERIA') AS is_algeria
    FROM part p
    JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n1.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'AFRICA'
      AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND p.p_type = 'LARGE BURNISHED TIN'
) AS all_nations
GROUP BY o_year
ORDER BY o_year;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Remove the inner join to nation n2; the supplier's nation name is only used for an ALGERIA membership test, which can be replaced with an uncorrelated IN subquery on the tiny nation table. This removes one hash join and reduces the row width flowing into the final aggregate (assuming TPC-H referential integrity: supplier.s_nationkey is a valid nation key).

Compute `volume` once in the derived table and return a boolean `is_algeria` flag, so the multiplication `l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)` is not evaluated twice in the aggregate and the CASE only tests a boolean.
Replace `o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'` with the half-open range `>= '1995-01-01' AND < '1997-01-01'`, which is index-friendly and semantically identical for DATE columns.
Keep the small derived table for single evaluation of `volume`; avoid creating CTEs since there is no repeated subexpression and the optimizer already pushes the part/date/region filters effectively.
